question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over sixteen years?
premises: The means is constant practice through yoga
The duration indicated is two times eight years
A resulting bodily form is stated
inference: Through constant yogic practice for sixteen years, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the form of a sixteen-year-old
